description: Task Engine lifecycle event type 'configUpdated'. Published when runtime configuration changes (concurrency, queue depth, priority, timeouts, retry) are applied (PRD cpt-cf-task-engine-fr-runtime-config). One event is published per affected queue: a single /admin/config save that touches several queues emits one event for each, and a change not tied to one queue (a task-type-pattern override or a global default) emits one event for every queue whose effective settings it changes. All events of one save share config_version. Subject is the affected queue. Derived from the Event Broker base event type; routed to the task_events topic and partitioned by subject (the queue ID) for per-queue ordering.

type.$comment: Pins the event-type identifier so an editor can validate a payload against this schema alone.

config_version.description: Runtime configuration version (te_runtime_config) that produced this change; shared by all events emitted for one save.

changed_keys.description: Configuration keys whose effective value for this queue changed.
